── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────
Flat book, no losses to mourn and no profits to protect — the whole
story is still the starvation. Since 05:00 not a single trade closed
and the hotset has been empty for 107 consecutive minutes. The 05:45
compactor cycle shows the exact two-part failure the last four
escalations named, live and unedited: a SHORT that cleared every
regime/confluence/trend gate was killed at approval for RSI 31.7 being
below the 45 floor, while six signals sit in PENDING waiting for a
top-10 list that has zero members. 51 of 76 expired shorts in the last
6h carry RSI < 45 — the generators keep writing entries the approval
layer is contractually required to refuse.

The winning side is unchanged and verified fresh in PostgreSQL at
05:47: 24h SHORT 13T 8W 62% +0.31 vs LONG 7T 1W 14% -0.39; 7d SHORT
+0.56 vs LONG -1.73 (82 longs, 2.2x the short count); auto-trader
shadow shorts 3/4 vs longs 0/4. Trail arming remains the win mechanism
— 7d trailed 54T 41W 75.9% +3.09 vs untrailed 66T 7W 10.6% -4.26; every
24h loser was unarmed (hard_max_loss x2, stale_exit, hard_sl,
cut-loser, manual_sl_hit, atr_sl_hit, trail_arm_timeout,
UNIVERSAL_MAX_HOLD). We aren't on the winning side because inventory
emits longs 2.2x faster than shorts regardless of tape — but with zero
open positions that tilt has cost nothing today; the cost is entirely
opportunity.

Opportunity cost is now measurable: 1h movers we hold no part of —
INIT +5.8% (ATR 2.97%), ZORA +1.9%, NIL +1.8%, GMX +0.9%; on the
bottom GRASS -2.1%, ALT -1.9%, KAS -1.7%. A tape with a +5.8% runner
and zero book means the filter stack, not the market, is the binding
constraint.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────
1. Escalate #5 to signal_compactor owner: the same two mechanisms are
   now reproduced live in-cycle (approval-floor block + PENDING on
   empty hotset). Band alignment of generators vs approval floors is

2. New risk short-flavored ONLY while 1m closes hold at/below EMA300

   close above. Re-test next cycle — flip rate is above p95.
3. Keep volume-buildup- ON (steer-001 retraction verified 05:47).
4. No new AI-trader pick until the 45-min cooldown expires (~06:15);
   USUAL LONG stands as manual/watchlist reference only — AI_TRADER
   is disabled, do not report any pick as FIRED.
5. When entries resume, favor setups where a trail can arm (+0.40%) —
